verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents an Alerts API that accepts alerts from monitoring systems and groups them into cases. Nothing in the evidence describes signature or HMAC verification of alert events, idempotency keys, or deduplication of retried notifications. Grouping alerts into cases is a different behavior, and the developer docs are password-gated, so no public evidence covers this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can verify alert-event authenticity and deduplicate retried notifications
